verdict.rationale: The docs show Vercel Sandbox runs full Linux microVMs with any distribution, custom OCI images, system-privileged processes (e.g., Docker) and live previews, so installing a headless browser is plausible, but no item explicitly documents running a headless browser or a desktop environment. Missing for 10: explicit docs or examples of headless browser support (e.g., Chromium/Playwright), any desktop/GUI/VNC environment capability, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
